result:
The digest runs from an hourly job, using existing unread notification rows as its source. In the current implementation, “sending” records an email event in the log; it does not deliver mail over a network.

1. **Trigger.** In [src/instrumentation.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/d43784f7-2444-4e39-ad39-6547394caa06/src/instrumentation.ts), `register()` starts the scheduler in the Node.js runtime. `startScheduler()` and `tick()` in [src/server/jobs/scheduler.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/d43784f7-2444-4e39-ad39-6547394caa06/src/server/jobs/scheduler.ts) tick every minute and enqueue `digest-email` at a 60-minute cadence. `drain()` and `runHandler()` in [src/server/jobs/queue.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/d43784f7-2444-4e39-ad39-6547394caa06/src/server/jobs/queue.ts) dispatch it to `runDigestEmailJob()`. An authenticated `POST` to [src/app/api/cron/digest/route.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/d43784f7-2444-4e39-ad39-6547394caa06/src/app/api/cron/digest/route.ts) can also invoke that job directly.

2. **Organizations and subscribers.** `runDigestEmailJob()` in [src/server/jobs/digest-email-job.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/d43784f7-2444-4e39-ad39-6547394caa06/src/server/jobs/digest-email-job.ts) first asks `listOrgIdsForRollup(50)` in [src/server/repositories/usage-repository.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/d43784f7-2444-4e39-ad39-6547394caa06/src/server/repositories/usage-repository.ts) for up to 50 organization IDs from usage rows, ordered by measurement time. It loads each organization; `shouldRunForOrg()` requires it to be unarchived and its configured `digestHourUtc` to equal the current UTC hour. The job also checks `digest_email` with `isEnabled()` and `buildFlagContext()`: [src/config/feature-flags.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/d43784f7-2444-4e39-ad39-6547394caa06/src/config/feature-flags.ts) enables it for Growth or higher, or via an enabled organization override.

   For each eligible organization, `listDigestRecipients()` in [src/server/services/digest-service.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/d43784f7-2444-4e39-ad39-6547394caa06/src/server/services/digest-service.ts) delegates to `listDigestSubscribers()` in [src/server/repositories/notification-preference-repository.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/d43784f7-2444-4e39-ad39-6547394caa06/src/server/repositories/notification-preference-repository.ts). That selects distinct users with at least one preference row in the organization where `digestOnly` is true; it does not check that row’s `email` or `inApp` values.

3. **Content.** The job sets a window from exactly 24 hours before its `now` through `now`, then calls `buildDigest()` for each subscriber. Earlier, `registerFanOut()` and `notify()` in [src/server/services/notification-service.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/d43784f7-2444-4e39-ad39-6547394caa06/src/server/services/notification-service.ts) turn events such as assignments, overdue issues, comments, mentions and member joins into notification rows. `notify()` excludes the actor, resolves each recipient’s preferences, and skips recipients with no channels.

   `buildDigest()` rechecks the organization and flag, then calls `listUnreadSince()` in [src/server/repositories/notification-repository.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/d43784f7-2444-4e39-ad39-6547394caa06/src/server/repositories/notification-repository.ts). It takes that recipient’s still-unread rows created at or after the window start, excludes rows after the window end, maps their ID, kind, title, link and creation time to `DigestEntry` values, and keeps the newest 50. This query does **not** filter entries by notification kind or by whether that kind is marked `digestOnly`: the preference determines subscription, while all qualifying unread rows can enter the bundle.

4. **Render and send.** If the bundle is nonempty and the user still exists, `renderDigest()` calls `renderEmail()` in [src/server/services/email-service.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/d43784f7-2444-4e39-ad39-6547394caa06/src/server/services/email-service.ts), passing the recipient’s name, count, window and first entry’s title. The current renderer produces a generic HTML table and plain text from those props; it does not call the separate `DigestEmail` component or render the full entry list. `sendEmail()` logs the recipient, subject and HTML size. After that succeeds, the job marks each bundled notification read, which prevents those same rows from being included on a later run.

A subscribed person can therefore receive no digest when their organization is absent from the selected usage batch, archived, outside its configured UTC hour, or lacks the enabled feature; when the user record is missing; or when there are no qualifying unread notifications in the 24-hour window. Notifications already read, older than the window, not yet created within it, or never inserted because all channels were disabled cannot make the bundle nonempty. A per-recipient build, render, send or mark-read error is logged and counted as a failure. Also, marking entries read prevents repeating those entries, but it is not a durable once-per-day send lock: a later invocation in the same hour can send again if other qualifying unread entries remain or arrive.
